content.short: Maestro is a fast Bitcoin RPC and UTXO API delivering real-time data and mempool alerts for DeFi apps.
content.description: Bitcoin wasn’t designed for complex apps like DeFi, so Maestro delivers a high‑performance Bitcoin RPC and a UTXO indexer API that expose real‑time blockchain data, mempool access, and event‑driven tooling. By taking on the heavy lifting of node operations and index construction, it lets developers avoid running full nodes or building custom indexers. This reduces backend complexity and accelerates the development of scalable, Bitcoin‑native applications that rely on timely, granular insights.
content.meta: Maestro provides a fast Bitcoin RPC and UTXO API with real-time data for DeFi apps. Discover Maestro and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
